name: event-ticket-maker
description: Issue QR-code tickets for your event and run check-in from a spreadsheet. Pick the guest list, enter the event name, time and place, and every guest gets a unique, hard-to-guess ticket code. Print three tickets per A4 page with a tear-off stub, or export one PDF per guest to send out, plus a check-in workbook with a signature column. On the day, pick the scanner's export together with the guest list to see who has arrived — unknown, mistyped and repeated scans are flagged. Codes stay the same when you reopen the list. Runs locally; no ticketing service or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 用一张表格给活动发二维码门票、做签到。选上嘉宾名单，填好活动名称、时间和地点，每位嘉宾都会拿到一个唯一、难以猜到的票号。可以 A4 一页打印 3 张带撕线存根的门票，也可以每人导出一份 PDF 电子票发出去，另附一份带签名栏的签到表。活动当天，把扫码枪导出的记录和名单一起选上，就能看到谁已经到场——不在名单上的、输错的、重复扫的都会标出来。重新打开名单时票号保持不变。在本地运行，不用票务服务，无需 API 密钥。
